assumptions.statement: The infrastructure is hosted in AWS, specifically using Route53 for DNS management.
assumptions.quote: All Terraform projects in that stack add records to Route53 zones to expose the service internally and/or externally.

assumptions.statement: Internal DNS zones within the same VPC cannot be delegated if the domains overlap, forcing a single-zone approach for internal resolution.
assumptions.quote: For internal domains we cannot replicate the external configuration because it's not possible to do DNS delegation with internal zones in the same VPC when the domains overlap.

assumptions.statement: Applications are designed to function correctly only when accessed via the specific publishing domain, not directly across independent infrastructure stacks.
assumptions.quote: Applications will not work correctly across independent stacks, and will only correctly work using the Publishing domain.
